span.p:
Message Queue (RabbitMQ / Kafka)
Exchange/Topic: cache.invalidation
Routing key: user.updated, product.changed, etc.
Message body: { "object_type": "user",
"object_id": 123,
"action": "update",
"changed_fields": ["avatar"] }

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 110px; text-align: center; width: 110px;

span.p:
Invalidation Consumer
1. Parse message
2. Resolve cache keys by type:
user.updated → ["user:123:profile",
"user:123:settings",
"feed:all:avatar"]
3. Dispatch deletes to cache cluster
4. Acknowledge message on success
5. On failure: retry with backoff (max 3)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 110px; text-align: center; width: 110px;

span.p:
Pro: App controls when invalidation happens
Con: App must remember to publish events
